## What landed

- **`tasks/detect.py` — catalog #10 runs.** `MaterializedInputs.contracts` + `_contract_candidates`: a contract subject whose `end_date` falls within the 90-day firing window **and** whose renewal terms are not on record mints `contract_expiring`, citing the firing `end_date` claim. `renewal_evidence` mirrors `exports.watch` rule 2 verbatim (recorded non-renewal or derivable auto-renewal = evidenced). Candidates now carry the spec's real facts, so `_expiry_priority` ranks nearer expiries first.
- **`tasks/research_pg.py` — the contract read seam.** `read_contract_expiry_inputs` reads current, never-superseded claims on `contract:*` subjects (the WX-01 family/predicate set, minus public-emission gates — tasks gate at export via `{PUB_TASK_GATE}`); degrades to `[]` honestly. `CLOSING_CONDITION_TEXT["contract_expiring"]` mirrors the catalog's closes.
- **`exports/task_export.py` + `spine_export.py` — task ↔ item links.** The watch payload builds once before the queue; `build_queue` maps `subject_key → emitted watch items` onto `card["watch_items"]` (the item's own handle, never re-derived). The `contract` trigger resolves the firing claim's `end_date` — the K11 title renders "… contract ending `<date>`".
- **`web/`** — `/watch/item/<handle>/` resolves each open task to its `/task/<handle>/` page (queue-anchor fallback, never a dead route); `/task/<handle>/` renders the `Watch:` item link.
